content:
Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the Final Answer Key for the Screening Test for the post of Assistant District Attorney (ADA) in the Prosecution Department, Haryana under Advertisement No. 18/2025.

Exam details

  • Post: Assistant District Attorney
  • Advt. No.: 18/2025
  • Screening Test date: 05 July 2026
  • Provisional answer key: around 08 July 2026 (objections as notified)
  • Final answer key: Available on HPSC Answer Key page

How to download

  1. Go to https://hpsc.gov.in
  2. Open Answer Key
  3. Select Final Answer Key for Screening Test – Assistant District Attorney (Advt. No. 18/2025)
  4. Download the PDF and match your responses

The result / further stages (including Subject Knowledge Test as applicable) will be prepared on the basis of this final answer key. Always use only the official HPSC website for download and updates.
